points.notes: The rational elliptic curve 1225.h2 (Cremona 1225h2, j = -7*137^3*2083^3 = -162677523113838677) has a rational 37-isogeny; the x-coordinates of the kernel points generate a totally real field K of degree 18 (disc 5^9*7^12*37^17), and the quadratic twist of 1225h2 by D = x0^3 + A4*x0 + A6 (short model) has the K-rational point Q = (D*x0, D^2) of order 37. Submitted curve = that twist over K = Q(a), a a root of the polredbest polynomial of the kernel polynomial. The point has degree 18 = gon_Q(X_1(37)), so it is not sporadic; it is isolated (P^1-isolated and AV-isolated) by the reference.
